requests.title: nextId > is one past the max id
requests.reason: The test's Todo literals use the old field `done`, which no longer exists on Todo. They are now `completed` so they still type-check against the renamed interface. The assertion and the expected result (8) are unchanged.

requests.title: format > formats open and done todos
requests.reason: The test's Todo fixtures use the old `done` field. Once Todo is renamed to `completed`, they no longer type-check. They also fail at runtime, because formatTodo now reads `completed`, so `{done: true}` would render as "[ ] eggs". I changed only the fixtures to use `completed`. The expected output strings are the same.

requests.title: storage > round-trips todos
requests.reason: The test fixture used the old `done` field. Todo now uses `completed`, and save must never write `done`, so a todo with `done` can no longer round-trip unchanged. I changed the fixture to use `completed: false`. The test checks the same thing as before.

requests.title: commands > adds and completes
requests.reason: The test reads `t.done`, but the Todo type renamed that field to `completed`. Left as is, it would not type-check and would get [undefined, undefined]. It now reads `t.completed` and checks for the same values ([true, false]).
